def VTask.map {α β} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) : Matroid β :=
  let ground := f '' M.E
  let indep (s : Set β) : Prop := s ⊆ ground ∧ ∃ t, M.Indep t ∧ s = f '' t
  Matroid.ofInd ground indep
    (by
      -- I1: Empty set is independent
      simp [indep]
      use ∅
      exact ⟨M.indep_empty, by simp⟩)
    (by
      -- I2: Subset of an independent set is independent
      rintro s t ⟨hst, ⟨t, hti, hse⟩⟩
      use t
      exact ⟨hti, hse⟩)
    (by
      -- I3: Augmentation axiom
      rintro s t ⟨_, ⟨s', hs', hse⟩⟩ ⟨_, ⟨t', ht', hte⟩⟩ hcard
      let s'' := s'.toFinset
      let t'' := t'.toFinset
      have hcard' : s''.card > t''.card := by
        rw [← hse, ← hte]
        exact hcard
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hxnot⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_of_card_gt hcard'
      let x' := f x
      have hxnot' : x' ∉ f '' t' := by
        intro h
        rcases h with ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        apply hf.injective
        exact ⟨hy, hx⟩
      have hnew := M.indep_add_card_gt hs' hx hxnot
      refine ⟨⟨f x, hxnot'⟩, ⟨t', ht', hte⟩⟩)
